result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but one visible localization/content defect stands out, with a couple of minor carousel and viewport presentation issues.

issues.description: The section heading displays the untranslated localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the localization key and display the intended heading, such as "Popular near you" or the correctly translated equivalent.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and the third "Fastest near you" restaurant card are visibly cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: If these are horizontal carousels, provide clearer affordance for horizontal scrolling and ensure the clipping looks intentional; otherwise adjust the layout to fit the viewport.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the visible lower restaurant card, making the card appear abruptly truncated at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content so cards can be fully viewed above the fixed navigation bar.
